title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer (m/f/d) – Multi-Agent Systems
description: Anyone can build an AI agent demo these days. Getting agents to run reliably in production, for thousands of users worldwide, is a different story. That's the job. For a renowned automotive manufacturer in Munich, we are looking for an AI Engineer to take an existing AI innovation platform to the next level. The platform is already live and used across the entire company. Now it is being expanded into a multi-agent system that develops ideas on its own, evaluates them, analyzes markets and competitors, and delivers a solid business case at the end. Humans stay in the loop where decisions matter. What makes this role different You don't write concepts that end up in a drawer. You build the actual system. One product, one team, one location, with no constantly changing client projects and no travel. You work directly with the innovation team and its users, see how they really work, and ship improvements in days, not quarters. Think startup speed, enterprise scale: you'll build a product used across a global organization, with direct access to users and the opportunity to make things happen. The goal is ambitious: a global rollout within 12 months and a lighthouse project for what AI can do inside a global corporation. What you will do Build and orchestrate multi-agent systems that carry an idea from the first sketch to the business case Engineer system prompts, RAG pipelines, evaluation frameworks and feedback loops that make the agents better every week Integrate the platform with enterprise systems, innovation processes and identity and permission concepts Run what you build, with CI/CD, MLOps, monitoring and an eye on cost and reliability Actively shape the global rollout What you bring A degree in computer science, electrical engineering, industrial engineering or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience Several years of building and shipping software in production, ideally LLM-based products used by real users Strong hands-on skills in Python (FastAPI) and TypeScript/React Practical experience with multi-agent orchestration (e.g. LangGraph or similar frameworks), RAG and LLM evaluation; familiarity with MCP is a plus Solid experience with cloud, DevOps and MLOps as well as APIs and authentication/authorization concepts An MVP-first mindset: you ship early, measure honestly and cut what doesn't work The ability to explain a technical trade-off to an executive in the morning and debug a pipeline in the afternoon Fluent English; German is a plus, but not a must You'll stand out if you have founded a company, been an early engineer at a startup, or worked as a forward deployed or solutions engineer. The essentials Start ASAP, on-site in Munich, full-time, with a long-term engagement initially planned for around two years. You will be employed by advanced engineering GmbH and work directly with our client's project team. Interested? Apply with the button on this page. No cover letter needed.
